original_test_intent: Verify the second Type 9 Slot Characteristics bitfield advertises the approved extended capabilities—such as supported management, hot-plug, bifurcation or removal behavior as defined by the applicable SMBIOS version—for each exact slot, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Preserve raw Type 9 formatted bytes, establish that the record length includes Characteristics 2, decode the second byte independently with the applicable SMBIOS definition, compare its exact mask per slot, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected second-byte masks, record-version/absence policy and reboot plan. Dynamic hot-plug, bifurcation or removal behavior is not exercised by this metadata case.
required_inputs: Expected raw Characteristics 2 mask per exact slot
Applicable SMBIOS version and Type 9 formatted length requirements
Board/riser capability map for each defined extended bit
Policy for absent field, reserved/unknown/vendor bits and unsupported features
Raw-capable parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not hot-plug cards, change bifurcation or test surprise removal in this case.
Verify record length before reading the second byte; absence in an older/shorter structure is not the same as a zero mask.
Preserve the raw second byte because decoded tools commonly combine both characteristic bytes into one Characteristics list.
Do not claim advertised hot-plug, PME, SMBus, bifurcation or removal behavior was functionally proven.
Stop on out-of-bounds parsing, reserved-bit assertion, version mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Check Type 9 structure length, extract the raw second characteristic byte when present, decode every defined/reserved bit by version and compare per slot before/after reboot.
Do not exercise dynamic slot features or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-slot extended-capability masks and absent/reserved-bit policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, authorize separate dynamic capability tests where required, and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `Slot Characteristics 2` grep is not reliable because typical dmidecode output combines both bytes under `Characteristics:`; `-A1` also cannot retain all asserted flags or establish field presence by structure length.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete decoded Type 9 output and raw formatted bytes, validate structure length, then emit the second-byte raw mask and all version-defined/reserved bits separately for every slot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Characteristics 2 scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; the original grep remains recorded but is not sufficient evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a raw-capable, version-aware parser that distinguishes field absence from zero, reports the Characteristics 2 byte and every decoded/reserved bit independently from Characteristics 1, and compares exact masks across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 9 records whose formatted length includes Slot Characteristics 2.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, Type 9 structure length and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 Slot Characteristics 2 layout and bit definitions, approved platform capability specification and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds record-length gating and raw second-byte decoding instead of relying on a likely absent/truncated label.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage by distinguishing absent versus zero and detecting every asserted/reserved second-byte bit without conflating first-byte flags.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Versioned per-slot masks and explicit absent-field policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Advertised capabilities do not prove live hot-plug, bifurcation, management signaling or surprise-removal behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept field absence only for a documented SMBIOS/structure version and may vary masks by riser; any dynamic capability test requires its own approved procedure and evidence.
expected_evidence: Approved platform revision, SMBIOS version, Type 9 length policy and per-slot Characteristics 2 masks
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with handle, designation, structure length, raw second byte and all decoded/reserved flags
Per-slot exact-mask result with absent-versus-zero distinction, separate from Characteristics 1
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot raw-mask diff
Engineer verdict; dynamic capability evidence separately identified

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Characteristics 2 is a canonical Type 9 formatted-area byte when the structure length includes it; source intent is sufficiently clear despite the inadequate grep.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Record-length-aware raw parsing resolves presence and content safely; missing masks/tools are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects an unreliable literal grep and adds structure-length and raw second-byte evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Resolves its canonical-field concern through length-gated Type 9 parsing and restores FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates static bitfield verification from any manual/dynamic hot-plug or removal test.

review_improvement: Prevents an absent field from being reported as zero, captures all extended flags and keeps functional hot-plug claims outside the static metadata result.
independent_technical_reasoning: The second characteristics byte is deterministically present or absent from the Type 9 formatted length; when present its version-defined mask can be decoded and compared entirely in software.
